artifact_evidence.checks: One actual isolated-execution observation per fixed check: check_id, program_sha256, stdin_sha256(canonical JSON), stdout, stderr, exit_code, timed_out, receipt_sha256. No model success metrics.
artifact_evidence.executions: Nonempty actual native program/procedure action observations for task itself, with durable original receipt identities/proofs. A post-hoc oracle execution alone is not native task execution.
artifact_evidence.files: Object containing program/result and optional preserved mapping by exact path. Each item: path, content, sha256, readback_content, readback_sha256, readback_receipt_sha256.
artifact_evidence.progress: Actual progress/action events and optional save_work_progress observations, retained for honest-work/overhead assessment. Mere plan words/counts give no semantic points.
artifact_evidence.reuse_probe: For multistep cases: same check fields plus dependency_source_sha256; execute same verified program against the trusted fixed dependency-probe fixture, separate cloned isolation only. Original task dependency remains byte-identical. This behavioral dependency observation establishes actual reuse rather than matching an import word.

Root must not read protected final fixtures/scorer or print prompts/oracles.
producerExportInterface.fixture_setup: Case initial files may be loaded into this task-scoped existing programming workspace by trusted setup. No oracle/expected outputs/scorer in model workspace or model context. Fixed actual initial task is not human repair.
producerExportInterface.ingress: Current DelegatedDigitalRunner/build_digital_runner on the normal current worker composition. Fresh host-bound private technical ConversationTurn; canonical current UTC; original ingress journal; exact current profile/grant accepted by profile.accepts_grant. No fake smaller grant. Limit case provider attempts through existing journal_factory maximum_model_requests<=4 plus physical helper/shared ledger. No old script execution.
producerExportInterface.policy_selection: Host extracts only the checked _work_strategy literal from exact source; all other runner bytes/profile/authorizer remain fixed. Runtime/source/SDK projection proof must establish the selected literal actually used.
producerExportInterface.program_result_readback: Read /workspace/main.py and /workspace/result.json through existing programming/procedure/physical file route independently after terminal work. Preserve supplied dependency file hashes. Never execute submitted code on host.
producerExportInterface.still_missing: Trusted producer/export construction and exact per-source receipt validation/readiness; these files prepare fixtures/scorers only and run no agent or native process.
producerExportInterface.usage_authority: Original normalized work receipt + each actual provider journal request, completion/failure and measured input/output; root stop/authority checks, current scope/profile and full action receipts supply trusted run_bindings; case/help/hard/artifact hashes under exact published schema.

remainingExecutionGate: Trusted producer/source-to-SDK binding, exact current installed profiles/scope, complete physical usage and real artifact exports must be proven before model input. Feasibility and every independent isolated check share the42attempt/200000token/70tool ceiling.
